about: Word fixes: when the recognizer writes "from", your text says "to". Applied in this order, after sentence capitalisation. "from" ignores case; separate alternatives with |, write phrases with their spaces. It is a regular expression, so jon(?='s) fixes "Jon's" but not "jons". capitalization: always (proper noun), matchHeard (capital only if the heard word had one), exact (written exactly as "to"). Optional: wholeWord (default true), endings (default 's|s, kept in lower case after the fix). Save the file and the next dictation uses it.
